summary: A --select whose names all resolve to nothing is skipped instead of gutting every nested array to `{}`.
reason: The stderr hint promised «will be ignored», but filterFieldsRec's envelope fallback still applied the selector inside every child array: `ddl get 18 779 --select iter` printed firmatari:[{},{}], and the same happened to eventi/atti/sezioni and to every cerca row, with or without --envelope.
validated_outcome: selettoreTuttoIgnoto gates filterFields in printOutputWithFlags and emitEnvelope; unit tests cover object-with-array, bare list, envelope and mixed selectors; live: ddl get/mozioni get/ddl iter/commissione dossier/ddl cerca keep full arrays with --select pippo.
